request.initial_prompt: Fool. Cry to it, nuncle, as the cockney did to the eels when she put 'em i' the paste alive; she knapped 'em o' the coxcombs with a stick and cried 'Down, wantons, down!' 'Twas her brother that, in pure kindness to his horse buttered his hay.

raw_segments.text: Fool, Cry to it, nuncle, as the cockney did to the eels when she put him i' the paste alive.
She knapped him o' the coxcombs with a stick and cried, Down, wantons, down!
Twas her brother that, in pure kindness to his horse buttered his hay.
Fool, cry to it Nunkle, as the cockney did to the eels when she put him I the paste
alive. She napped him O, the cock scomes with a stick and cried down, wantons down. Twas
her brother that in pure kindness to his horse buttered his hay.
